title: Poseidon temple on Little St. James and Atlantis labyrinth at Zorro Ranch
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Poseidon temple on Little St. James and Atlantis labyrinth at Zorro Ranch, about 2000s-2010s at Little St. James; Zorro Ranch, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: patron deity. And then on Zoro Ranch, where the breeding program was, he had a labyrinth in the shape of the ground plan of Atlantis.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a philosopher, says, relaying a commentator known as Dark Journalist, that a temple on a property called Little St. James was built to Poseidon, the Greek sea god, as a patron deity. He adds that on another property, Zorro Ranch, where he says a breeding programme took place, the owner built a labyrinth laid out like the plan of Atlantis, the lost island Plato describes in his ancient dialogues Timaeus and Critias, which Jorjani takes as a sign of hidden beliefs at work.
